meta.name: i-have-adhd
meta.description: Shape output for a reader with ADHD. Use this skill whenever responding to ANY user message including coding tasks, debugging, explanations, planning, and casual conversation. Output should lead with concrete next actions, number multi-step work, externalize state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, and make wins visible. Trigger even on casual messages and even when the user did not explicitly ask for brevity.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为ADHD读者调整输出格式，突出行动要点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需为注意力分散的读者提供清晰、可执行的回复
copy.tagline_en: Format output for ADHD readers, highlighting actionable steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to provide clear, actionable responses for readers with attention challenges

howto.what: Claude 会以可执行的动作开头，用编号列表分解多步骤任务，每轮对话结束时给出一个具体下一步，抑制无关话题，每轮重述当前进度，给出具体时间估算，并明确展示已完成的工作。
howto.when: 每次回复用户消息时自动触发，包括编程、调试、解释、规划及日常对话，即使未明确要求简洁。

say.text: 帮我修复这个登录bug，先告诉我第一步做什么。
列出部署步骤，每步一个编号。
say.note: Claude 会给出编号列表，每步一个独立操作。

say.text: 解释这个算法，但不要任何开场白。
say.note: Claude 会直接解释，无“好的”等前缀。

howto.what_en: Claude leads with a concrete next action, numbers multi-step tasks, ends each turn with one next step, suppresses tangents, restates progress every turn, gives specific time estimates, and makes completed work visible.
howto.when_en: Triggered on every user message, including coding, debugging, explanations, planning, and casual conversation, even without explicit request for brevity.

say_en.text: Help me fix this login bug, tell me the first step.
say_en.note: Claude will start with an action like 'Open src/auth.ts'.

say_en.text: List the deployment steps, each numbered.
say_en.note: Claude will output a numbered list with one action per step.

say_en.text: Explain this algorithm, but no preamble.
say_en.note: Claude will explain directly without greetings.
